layout_defects_found.details: The file contained two `## Provider/model precedence and settings resolution` headings, which made heading-based packet targeting ambiguous.
The file contained two `### Three-axis settings model` headings with different semantics, which made bounded child-heading targeting ambiguous.

Owner-scope canon for run/seam/package/node/overseer/delegated-subagent scope, parallel-node worktree assignment, and ownership transitions lived in untitled preamble text directly under the owner heading.
The canonical owner section ended in malformed `---## 1. Canonical model identifier` markup, which blurred the owner-section boundary needed for bounded packet replacement.

repairs_applied.repair: Added `### Scope and owner boundaries` and moved/restated the owner-scope preamble there so the canonical owner content has a unique child anchor.
Kept the early owner section as canonical and left exactly one `### Three-axis settings model` heading under it.

Renamed the later duplicate owner section to `## Provider/model selection policy and audit addendum` and renamed its duplicated child heading to `### Persona, execution-unit, and scope policy inputs` so its unique addendum content remains preserved without colliding with canonical anchors.
repairs_applied.canonical_heading: ## Provider/model selection policy and audit addendum
repairs_applied.safe_anchor_after_repair: ### Persona, execution-unit, and scope policy inputs

repairs_applied.repair: Split malformed `---## 1. Canonical model identifier` markup into a horizontal rule plus a separate `## 1. Canonical model identifier` heading so the canonical owner section has a clear bounded end.
